crossRefs.note: He who tills his land shall have plenty of bread, but he who chases fantasies is void of understanding.
A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth. The work of a man’s hands shall be rewarded to him.
Whoever tends the fig tree shall eat its fruit. He who looks after his master shall be honored.
Know well the state of your flocks, and pay attention to your herds:
One who works his land will have an abundance of food; but one who chases fantasies will have his fill of poverty.
Moreover the profit of the earth is for all. The king profits from the field.
Go to the ant, you sluggard. Consider her ways, and be wise;
The righteousness of the blameless will direct his way, but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.
The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them, but the unfaithful will be trapped by evil desires.
It is well with the man who deals graciously and lends. He will maintain his cause in judgment.
Whoever keeps the commandment shall not come to harm, and his wise heart will know the time and procedure.
For there is a time and procedure for every purpose, although the misery of man is heavy on him.
Yes, the stork in the sky knows her appointed times. The turtledove, the swallow, and the crane observe the time of…

translations.web: An abundance of food is in poor people’s fields, but injustice sweeps it away.
translations.bsb: Abundant food is in the fallow ground of the poor, but without justice it is swept away.
translations.kjv: Much food is in the tillage of the poor: but there is that is destroyed for want of judgment.
translations.asv: Much food is in the tillage of the poor; But there is that is destroyed by reason of injustice.
